V3 presents the quest script with backgrounds and portraits still under artistic review. The illustrated map marks quests, invitations, and interventions available now. Choose a destination to see its activities. On touchscreens, tap to select it, then tap again to visit. Finish the conversation or battle before using the portal back to Story Night. Checking your journal, items, or team does not advance the campaign.

Exploration opens after Q-A1. Hearing a proposal does not commit you to a guild. Joining a guild and closing recruitment each require confirmation. Ghork can finish the campaign alone without spending Ludos. Defeats allow free rematches.

Experimental economy: short conflicts award 2 Ludos; long conflicts and side quests award 3. Standard paid choices and rerolls cost 1; recruitment exceptions cost 3. B4 and C4 have difficulty 8. The tournament and final confrontation have difficulties of 8, 9, 10, 11, 12, and 12. Your D20 roll plus allies must exceed the difficulty. A tie is a loss.

Earlier V3 saves remain compatible. Save formats older than V3 are not accepted. Export and import let you move your progress between browsers or devices. Scenes and variants and Art inventory are review tools separate from your game.
